page_note: IEA《Clean Energy Market Monitor – March 2024》第19页，用六个小图展示2019–2023年世界及主要市场电动汽车销量与各地区避免的排放量。

heading.title: Electric car sales and avoided emissions
heading.unit_text: Million units / Thousand units / Mt CO₂

figures.value_axis_ticks: World: 15, 10, 5; China: 9, 6, 3; European Union: 3, 2, 1; United States: 1.5, 1.0, 0.5; India: 90, 60, 30; Avoided emissions: 10, 20

components.evidence: each panel carries a bold title above it, e.g. "United States", "India"
"Avoided emissions" is horizontal bars by region; the other five are vertical bars by year
top ticks differ: World 15, China 9, European Union 3, United States 1.5, India 90
in "Avoided emissions" regions sit on the y axis, bars grow right to 22, 15, 14, 3, 7
white numbers printed on the bars: "13.7", "8.1", "2.4", "1.4", "82", "22"
India 2019 "1" and 2020 "3" set in black above their near-invisible bars
"Million units" and "Thousand units" set vertically along the left axes
bare ticks 5/10/15 with scale only in axis title "Million units"; India "Thousand units"
"Mt CO₂" printed under the 10, 20 ticks of the "Avoided emissions" panel
dotted horizontal rules at each tick in the five sales panels, no vertical rules
"Avoided emissions" panel has dotted vertical rules at 10 and 20 only
"Notes: "Avoided emissions" refers to avoided emissions in one year from cumulative deployment since 2019 to 2023."
"Mt CO₂" carries subscript 2 in the axis unit under the avoided-emissions panel

new_components.name: panel_fill_color_marks_aggregate
new_components.evidence: "World" bars drawn dark orange, the four country/region panels yellow, avoided emissions teal
new_components.why_it_matters: 颜色不区分系列而区分面板层级，读数时必须靠面板标题而非颜色定位，聚合面板（World）不能与分区面板混读。

new_components.name: blank_category_slot_before_residual_row
new_components.evidence: an empty row gap separates "United Kingdom" from "Rest of world" in the avoided emissions panel
new_components.why_it_matters: 类别轴上有一个无标签空槽，解析成表格时容易多出空行或错位，使 7 被错配到 United Kingdom。

new_components.name: per_panel_unit_change
new_components.evidence: India axis reads "Thousand units" while other sales panels read "Million units"
new_components.why_it_matters: 同一图内单位随面板变化，82 与 13.7 不能同尺度比较，取值必须连同该面板单位一起给出。

the 2021 bar in the United States panel

difficulty_notes: 五个销量面板共用完全相同的类别轴 2019–2023，且数值大量重复："1.0" 同时是 European Union 2020 与 United States 2022，"0.3" 在 United States 出现两次，"1.1" 在 China 出现两次。因此仅靠 年份+数值 无法唯一定位，必须带上面板名 World/China/European Union/United States/India，而这些名字只是各面板上方的粗体小标题，位于任何解析出的表格之外；若导出时未把它们写成标题或粗体行，13.7 与 6.0 之类的值就无法被寻址。相反，数值本身全部印在柱上（13.7、8.1、82），第2步几乎不构成障碍，5% 容差与 5/10/15 的刻度间距无关。

suggestions.what_to_add: panel_title_per_panel 与 per_panel_axis_range 组合：把面板名并入检索键
suggestions.where_to_change: 记录字段中增加 panel_key，并在条件行里让同一份年份类别在多面板间重复
suggestions.new_ablation_row: 有/无 panel_key 时，重复类别轴（2019–2023×5面板）下数值寻址成功率对比

suggestions.what_to_add: 新组件 per_panel_unit_change（Million units vs Thousand units vs Mt CO₂）
suggestions.where_to_change: 样式字段的单位位置维度，允许每面板独立的旋转轴标题与轴下单位
suggestions.new_ablation_row: 单位统一 vs 单位随面板变化时，数值+单位联合命中率一行

suggestions.what_to_add: value_label_outside 与 value_label_inside 混用（India 的 1、3 在柱外，其余在柱内）
suggestions.where_to_change: 样式字段 value-label placement 允许按柱高自动外移
suggestions.new_ablation_row: 极小柱（<轴上限4%）标签内置 vs 外置时的标签-柱归属正确率

suggestions.what_to_add: heterogeneous_panel_types（纵向时间柱 + 横向区域柱同图）
suggestions.where_to_change: 图族权重向量中加入“同一图内混合族”的生成比例
suggestions.new_ablation_row: 纯同族小多图 vs 含异族面板页面的整页导出准确率

suggestions.what_to_add: 标题块拆分：无编号标题 + 无副标题 + 单位在轴（P7 字段化）
suggestions.where_to_change: 图题字段化为 number/title/subtitle/unit/placement，本页 figure_number 为空
suggestions.new_ablation_row: 无编号图题在整页 markdown 中作为标题输出与否的上下文命中率
